messages:
Mia P: Quick sync — need to lock acceptance criteria + rollout plan for the econ advisor playbook (batching / caching / quant recommendations + eval-triggered alerts). Pilot customers in ~3 weeks, helpers?
Raj K: +1. Can we do an MVP that is advice-only (no auto-apply) and supports static batching + prefix caching? simpler infra surface.
Sophie L: Important: BetaHealth asked for per-model quantization guidance (FP16 vs Q4_0 vs Q4_1) — they care about quality regressions. UI should expose per-model toggles, not global.
Diego: Infra note: static batching + prefix cache is straightforward. KV cache needs eviction metrics. Suggest adding 'cache_size_bytes' and 'evictions/sec' to telemetry.
Diego: PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/kv-cache/pull/42 — contains LRU sketch and eviction telemetry.
Mia P: Eval alerting — we need thresholds and signal defs. Proposal: monitor a curated prompt set per-customer; trigger if concordance drops >=3% or response quality score falls by 0.05 over a 24h window.
casey_support: +1 but add rate-limit on alerts. Also require manual ack by CS before escalation. Customers want control over which prompt sets are monitored.
Raj K: Implementation note: eval hooks will be a small webhook that sends (model, prompt_set_id, metric, delta). We can gate alerts behind account-level feature flag.
Sophie L: For rollout gating: dogfood -> 2 beta customers (Acme & BetaHealth) -> staged rollout. Acceptance criteria for beta: <2% false positives in eval alerts and recommendations have >80% acceptance by SEs.
Mia P: Decision: MVP scope = advice-only quant recommendations (per-model), static batching heuristics, prefix KV caching, eval-triggered alerts (thresholded, ack workflow). No auto-apply for Q1.
Diego: Risk: quant recommendations require offline eval harness. Ops estimate: ~3 sprint infra work + 2 sprints product integration.
Mia P: Owners & next steps:
- Raj K (eng): static batching + alert webhook (due 2w)
- Diego (engops): KV cache telemetry + eviction policy (due 2w)
- Sophie L (product): quant recommender spec + UI mocks (due 1w)
- casey_support: beta onboarding checklist + alert ack flow (due 1w)
Mia P: Can folks confirm ownership & dates? If no objections I'll add to sprint board and notify sales/customer success. :+1:
Raj K: Confirmed.
Diego: Confirmed.
Sophie L: Confirmed, will post mocks by EOD Fri.
casey_support: Confirmed, will start outreach to Acme.
ops-bot: Reminder set: follow-up sync scheduled 2024-12-05 10:00 UTC.
